title: [Bug] Inline rename edit box shifts and shows ghost text behind it
author: julesbobb
body_snippet:
## Describe the bug
When triggering an inline rename on any connection or folder node (via **Right-click → Rename**, or **F2**), the label edit box appears at an incorrect offset. Additionally, the original node text remains visible behind the edit box as a "ghost" or shadow artifact.

## Steps to reproduce
1. Open the **Connection Tree**.
2. Right-click any connection or folder and select **Rename** (or press **F2**).
3. Observe the positioning of the edit box.
